integrity: The included executable finite checks supplement a complete symbolic argument; they are not a substitute for its use of the standard primitive-prime-divisor theorem. Originality remains subject to potentially unindexed earlier publications. Independent audit has not been conducted.
scientific_limitations: The construction uses classical Bang–Zsigmondy and the prime number theorem; it does not determine the global density or asymptotic number of semi-Carmichael semiprimes, the least usable larger prime for each smaller prime, or the arithmetic structure of all semi-Carmichael numbers.
title: Primitive prime divisors yield infinitely many two-prime semi-Carmichael integers
